import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Melt the data to pivot the product and size
melted_data = pd.melt(coffee_sales, id_vars=['date', 'time', 'price', 'quantity', 'payment_method', 'customer_age_group', 'is_takeaway', 'total'], value_vars=['product', 'size'])

# Group by the melted data to get the product and size counts
product_counts = melted_data.groupby(['variable', 'value'])['price'].count().reset_index()

# Pivot the data to get the product and size counts
product_size_counts = product_counts.pivot(index='value', columns='variable', values='price').fillna(0)

# Plot the bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.heatmap(product_size_counts, annot=True, cmap='Blues', fmt='d')
plt.title('Product and Size Sales Counts')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Size')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Load the data

# Melt the data to pivot the product and size

# Group by the melted data to get the product and size counts
product_counts = melted_data.groupby(['variable', 'value'])['price'].count().reset_index()

# Pivot the data to get the product and size counts
product_size_counts = product_counts.pivot(index='value', columns='variable', values='price').fillna(0)

# Plot the bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.heatmap(product_size_counts, annot=True, cmap='Blues', fmt='d')
plt.title('Product and Size Sales Counts')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Size')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
